csv_project_name: Landscape Architect For Clark Park Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Molalla Community Development Department ( CITY) has identified the need for a highly-qualified and experienced professional park landscape architectural firm to develop preliminary design and construction cost estimates for various park layout alternatives for the CLARK PARK IMPROVEMENTS. Clark Park is located just west of the Molalla Buckaroo grounds and NE of the Shirley Street and N. Cole Avenue intersection, in Molalla, Oregon. Approximately 2/3 of the park is covered in large oak trees, in which are located playground equipment, ADA paths, picnic tables, a covered gazebo, covered picnic facility and restrooms. The remainder of the park has a softball field and a large undeveloped large grass field.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering
